version_normalisation: The approved draft content was promoted atomically to contract and schema version 1.0.0 so the human contract, schema, eligibility method and fixtures use one release version.

approved_decisions.H1: Carry the full immutable A1 Prospect Candidate snapshot with deterministic SHA-256 integrity.
approved_decisions.H2: Allow unavailable HubSpot/Twenty checks for the manual no-integration pilot while blocking writes, outreach eligibility and production routing.
approved_decisions.H3: Require approved_for_a2, approved human decision, reviewer, timestamp and pass_to_a2 recommendation.
approved_decisions.H4: Block confirmed exclusions, confirmed duplicates and invalid candidates; hold possible duplicates and unresolved material conflicts.
approved_decisions.H5: Keep A1 score, evidence and approval immutable and return material new evidence through a separate requalification path.
approved_decisions.H6: Cap manual no-integration handoffs at ready_for_delivery; only durable integration may claim delivered and only A2 may claim accepted_by_a2.

not_approved: field catalogue and minimum data packages
next_gate: Canonical A2 Enrichment Record design and deterministic validation
